mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOprAgree (Title, Cntnts, AttrSeq, ChnlCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate) VALUES (#{title}, #{cntnts}, #{attrSeq}, #{chnlCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tOprAgree SET AgreeNo = #{agreeNo}, Title = #{title}, Cntnts = #{cntnts}, AttrSeq = #{attrSeq}, ChnlCode = #{chnlCode}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE AgreeNo = #{agreeNo}
mapper.select: SELECT Cntnts FROM shopion.tOprAgree WHERE AgreeNo = #{value}
